role: Convert episodic reasoning experiences into long-term structural knowledge proposals via frequency-based pattern detection.
detail: Consolidation engine processes recent ReasoningEpisode nodes and identifies patterns (repeated query subjects, failures, confidence trends, knowledge gaps) using frequency-based analysis (no ML). Core classes: ConsolidationEngine (main orchestrator), SchemaProposal (guardian-reviewed suggestion), ConsolidationAnalysis (pattern results), ConsolidationReport (full cycle output). Key methods: sample_recent_episodes() (weighted random sampling), analyze_episodes() (detect repeated subjects, failure patterns, confidence trends, gaps), generate_proposals() (translate patterns to NEW_CONCEPT/CONFIDENCE_ADJUSTMENT/RELATIONSHIP_SUGGESTION/PRACTICE_RECOMMENDATION), run_consolidation() (full async pipeline). Enforces temporal guards (min 30min runtime, 5min idle before first run, max 3 per session). Writes SchemaProposal nodes with status=PENDING; never modifies graph directly (CANON A.5). Also integrates grounding_maintenance engine as fire-and-forget step (Phase 2 conversation engine).
gotchas: sample_recent_episodes uses weighted sampling favoring complex (many steps) and uncertain (low confidence) episodes; confidence trend delta compared against _TREND_THRESHOLD (0.05) to determine improving/declining/stable; knowledge gap detection queries persistence.get_node() for each referenced concept; grounding_maintenance integration is fire-and-forget with exception swallow (line 814); proposal_confidence for RELATIONSHIP_SUGGESTION computed as min(0.7, 0.3 + 0.1 * (count - _MIN_REPEAT_COUNT))
